flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi sftp-prod.properties:87-90 and utilities/sftpComponent/SftpConfig (ICMS config only); ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase (no decision column); ocmsadminui pages/Notice/form/History.tsx (Court Application History tab commented out). ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no code
note: Sheet status and demo_remark are blank; story traced normally. The story asks the OIC to record a decision (e.g. manual application submitted in ICMS, maintain rejection) and OCMS to follow up accordingly. Grep 'maintain reject', 'manual appl', 'icms' across the six repos: ICMS is only SFTP config (sftp-prod.properties:87-90, SftpConfig.java) with no job. There is no decision screen, no column to store the decision and no follow-up logic. It depends on the work item (OCMS24.19), which does not exist either. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: No code for this story. Do not claim as done.

steps.step: The OIC opens the rejected record and picks a decision (manual application in ICMS or maintain rejection)
steps.detail: No decision screen or option exists. The 'Court Application History' tab (CourtApplicationHistoryGrid, History.tsx:71) is commented out at History.tsx:170-172, and grep 'maintain reject' and 'manual appl' returns 0 results across the six repos.

steps.step: OCMS stores the OIC decision on the record
steps.detail: The OcmsCourtCase entity only has notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason (lines 24-31); there is no decision column or endpoint. No work item table exists to hold it either.

steps.step: OCMS follows up according to the decision selected
steps.detail: No follow-up logic exists. ICMS is only SFTP connection config (sftp-prod.properties:87-90) with no job or service using it; the 'manual application submitted in ICMS' value is not handled anywhere. Whether ICMS is used outside the six repos cannot be verified from repo.
